title: Front Street project shoreline setback variance
summary: At the October 6 meeting, a board member called the project's second submittal incomplete, saying the drawings did not show the building outside the 40-foot shoreline setback. The project team said it is not a rebuild because that part of the lot was undeveloped before.

timeline.text: A board member said the drawings did not show the building outside the 40-foot shoreline setback (the required distance from the shoreline).
The project team said it is not a rebuild, because that part of the lot was undeveloped before.
